title: Ports and exposure
description: Change the port this app listens on, and choose how it can be reached. Many apps can use the same container port: each one gets its own host port.
containerPortHelp: The port the app listens on inside its container.

mode.label: Exposure
mode.proxiedHelp: Reachable by its domain, or the automatic hostname, on ports 80 and 443. Other apps reach it by name. No host port is opened.
mode.directHelp: Also published on a host port and opened in the host firewall, so you can check the app at the server address. This is plain HTTP and bypasses TLS and auth gates.

hostPortHelp: Leave empty to pick a free port in {{lo}} to {{hi}} automatically.
recreates: The container is recreated with the new settings. The image is not rebuilt or pulled again.
remoteNode: This app runs on another node. Direct host ports are only available for apps on the control plane's own node.
plainHttpWarning: Plain HTTP: traffic is not encrypted and basic auth or sign-in gates configured on the domain do not apply on this port.

urls.title: Where it answers
urls.none: No public URL yet. Add a domain, turn on automatic hostnames, or use direct IP and port.
urls.internal: Other apps on this server reach it by its app name on port {{port}}.

check.scope: Probed from the control plane host. This cannot prove the port is open to the whole internet.

failures.container_not_running: The container is not running, so there is nothing to reach. Start or redeploy the app.
failures.container_not_listening: The container is up but nothing answers on its published port. The app may not listen on the container port above, or it may still be starting.
failures.firewall_closed: The server address does not answer on this port. The host firewall or your cloud provider's security group is probably closed.
failures.unreachable_from_host: The ingress did not answer from this server. Check that ports 80 and 443 are being served.
failures.tls_not_issued: The certificate is not trusted yet. The ingress serves a temporary certificate and retries the public CA on its renewal cycle.
failures.proxy_route_missing: The proxy answered but has no route for this hostname. Check the domain is attached to this app.
failures.upstream_failing: The proxy has a route but the app behind it is not answering.
failures.app_error: The app answered with a server error.

inUse.title: Host ports in use on this node
inUse.empty: No host ports are pinned or published by apps or the control plane.

errors.invalidPort: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65535.

tunnel.title: Reach a private port
tunnel.description: Open a local port that tunnels to this app without publishing it. Needs the CLI signed in with an operator token.
